title: DeFi total value locked reaches new milestone despite market
content: TL;DR: Despite continued market volatility, DeFi's total value locked (TVL) has reached a new milestone, signaling persistent demand for decentralized financial services and yield opportunities outside traditional banking. However, this growth often comes with inherent smart contract risks and centralization vectors, starkly contrasting with Bitcoin's unyielding, computationally secured monetary base. For transactors, prioritizing the verifiable security of Bitcoin's network over speculative DeFi yields remains paramount for long-term monetary sovereignty.
author: Al Ingle
